description:
Configure compliance recording settings for the 'Financial Services Outbound' campaign (ID: FINSVC01). 

Log in to the Vicidial Admin interface (User: 6666, Pass: andromeda) if prompted. Navigate to the Campaigns section, modify campaign FINSVC01, and apply the following strictly enforced recording settings:

1. Recording Mode: Set to 'ALLFORCE' (Record all calls, agents cannot stop it).
2. Recording Filename: Set exactly to 'FINSVC01_|FULLDATE|_|CUSTPHONE|_|AGENT|' to meet audit requirements.
3. All Calls Delay: Set to '3' seconds to skip connection noise.

Ensure you submit/save the changes.
